title: Refinement Exchange Coherence
statement:
Let $B$ be a commutative ring. Use $D(\mathcal T_T)$ for strict towers of constant $B$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale site of each scheme $T$, with the operations $G_u,R_u^{\mathcal T},J_j$ of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. For every commutative square with proper verticals and quasi-compact open horizontals use the normalized comparison $\gamma_Q$ and open base-change map $\beta$ of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. All direct-image and open-extension composition identifications are canonical.
Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type and let $c_i=(j_i:X\hookrightarrow\overline X_i,p_i:\overline X_i\to Y)$ be supplied compactifications [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. For a refinement $u:c_1\to c_2$ (a proper $Y$-map with $uj_1=j_2$), let $Q_u$ have top $j_1$, bottom $j_2$, left $1_X$, right $u$. Put $F_i=R_{p_i}^{\mathcal T}J_{j_i}$ and
$$C_u=R_{p_2}^{\mathcal T}\gamma_{Q_u}:F_2\longrightarrow F_1.$$
Restrict to $M\in D(\mathcal T_X)$ whose evaluations are restrictions of scalars along maps $B\to\Lambda_n$, with $\Lambda_n$ finite commutative, of $\nu_X^*L_n$ for $L_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda_n)$ [def-cbc-finite-constant-coefficient-transport]. Then $C_u$ is an isomorphism. For every base change $g:Y'\to Y$ put $e_i=(R_{p_i'}^{\mathcal T}\beta_{j_i,g})E_{p_i}^{\mathcal T}:G_gF_i\to F_i'G_{g'}$, where $E$ is the proper pullback-square mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. In the derived strict-tower category itself,
$$C'_u e_2=e_1G_gC_u,\qquad C_{\mathrm{id}}=1,\qquad C_{v\circ u}=C_uC_v.$$
For a common refinement $d\xrightarrow{u_i}c_i$ define $I_{12}=C_{u_2}^{-1}C_{u_1}:F_1\to F_2$. These isomorphisms are independent of the common refinement and the refinement arrows, satisfy $I_{23}I_{12}=I_{13}$, and intertwine the $e_i$. No qcqs or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on $Y$; compactifications are supplied.
